text: Happeet does exactly what it says on the box. It's a no-frills habit tracker. The ads are non-intrusive and the design choices are very cute. Even the more intricate mechanics (e.g limited time habits) are presented in a straightforward way. You can track multiple habits and see your consistency for each one in an individual graph. All of the menus are clear. I've downloaded four habit trackers and this is the only one I kept. It's layout is simple and immaculate. 10/10 can't recommend it enoug
